description: Single synthetic fixture shared by the TypeScript core and the Java native timer repository. t = 2026-11-09T07:00:00+08:00; mono0 = 10000000; boot = b1. Segment ids starting with @ are newly generated ids bound per language: TS must match makeIds in order, Java asserts non-empty/unique and reuses the binding.

cases.label: closed segment edit keeps id/bounds/source; open awake cannot switch to sleep; missing id and invalid category reject
closed split preserves 180123ms outer bound, assigns a fresh id per new part, inherits source and lineage
open split backfills a completed nap window and leaves the last part open at 0; the shared summary at t+4m reports nap 60000ms and actual awake 180000ms
open split cannot make the live tail a nap
an open sleep segment cannot be split until the nap ends
split against the pre-edit snapshot rejects and keeps the newer note
merge two contiguous closed segments keeps first id, outer bounds, note and notification source
merge into a running open tail stays open and keeps both notes
merge rejects pause gaps, reversed order and non-adjacent picks without mutation
merge cannot turn an open nap into an awake category
merge cannot turn an open awake tail into a nap
summary at t+6h: main 8h, nap 2h, total 10h, awake 4h; TS base budget 16h vs Java nap-inclusive budget 14h
native lifecycle: lap note/source belongs to the closed segment, nap excluded from closedCount, restart keeps cycle target and gaps, close keeps notification pref
wall clock back-jump is corrected by the monotonic anchor; end/open share t+60000 and clockAnomaly is set
wall/mono divergence of exactly 5000ms is not flagged
wall/mono divergence of 5001ms is flagged
new boot ignores the old monotonic anchor and re-anchors the split tail on the current boot
store.put failure rejects lap/edit/split/startNap atomically, then retry succeeds after the store recovers
Java startCycle rejects wake>now and sleepAt<=0, but accepts a 30m and a 25h sleep that TS validateSleepInput rejects
a notification-bar lap closes the old snapshot, so a stale split and a wrong cycleId are rejected without losing the new segment
merge note/source: TS trims and prefers notification, Java keeps first note verbatim and first source
null note: Java setSegmentDetails normalises to empty string, TS editSegment rejects non-string
overlapping work[0,2h] and nap[1h,3h]: TS clips overlap (nap 1h, awake 2h), Java sums nap (2h, awake 1h)
closed cycle summary caps at closedAtMs even when now is later; gap stays unclassified
